[bystrosc].description.t: A keen eye: ranged accuracy, spotting ambushes and keeping your head in a fight.

[fart].description.t: A bit of luck: critical hits and misfires, yours and other people's.

[krzepa].description.t: A hard body: HP and resistance to wounds, poison and stunning.

[oglada].description.t: A smooth tongue: talk, trade and persuasion, so nobody spits at your feet.

[rozum].description.t: A sharp head: skill points on level-up, knowledge and crafts.

[sila].description.t: Arm power: melee blows, carrying and spanning a crossbow.

[zrecznosc].description.t: Quick hands and feet: hitting, dodging, action points and throwing.
